notes: Two taḥwīl branches (Sulayman ibn Harb, Muhammad ibn Kathir) meet at شعبة, then share the rest of the chain in shared_tail.
«- قال ابن كثير عن أبي المطوس، عن أبيه -» is a variant reading of the same saying: a variant group, never a route of the main chain.
The shared tail's «ابن مطوس» and the variant's «أبي المطوس» are the two readings of one link; the text gives both.
